ambiguities_or_notes: однодворка is rendered ‘smallholder,’ a historical smallholding rural status.
Обегала двор и сына извощика is syntactically opaque in the source; English preserves its roughness and flags the relation to the cabman son rather than inventing a full narrative.
зажитые деньги is rendered ‘money earned’ in the sense of money accrued/earned while serving; the note remains fragmentary.
